name: About the Journey: Closing the Distance
source:
After 10 years apart, childhood friends Freya and Ophelia are reunited!

Together, they embark on a 3,500-mile, coast-to-coast rail journey across the United States. Confined to their small cabin, their friendship is reignited and tested like never before. Can the two girls overcome the time and distance that has separated them for so long, and how will their relationship evolve if they can?

[From [url=https://watercress.itch.io/about-the-journey]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阔别10年后，儿时好友弗雷亚和奥菲莉亚重聚！

他们一起踏上了横跨美国的3,500英里、从东海岸到西海岸的铁路之旅。被限制在他们的小木屋里，他们的友谊重新点燃并受到前所未有的考验。两个女孩能否克服分隔已久的时间和距离？如果可以的话，她们的关系将会如何发展？

[来自[url=https://watercress.itch.io/about-the-journey]itch.io[/url]]
